hetzner401.help:
The Hetzner Cloud API returned a non-2xx response. Common causes:
• 401 unauthorized — the stored API token was rotated or revoked: renew the target's token.
• 403 forbidden — the token's project lacks permission for this resource type.
• 429 rate limit — back off and retry; if it persists, the project may need a quota increase.
• 5xx — an outage at the provider; check https://status.hetzner.com/.
hetzner401.message: hetzner-cloud GET /v1/locations failed (status 401): unauthorized: unable to authenticate

tokenRejected.help:
The provider's read-only credential check returned 401 / unauthorized. Either the token was mistyped, never had the right scopes, or has been rotated / revoked since you copied it.
• Verify the token at https://console.hetzner.cloud/projects → Security → API Tokens. It must say `Read & Write` next to the project.
• Copy the token again (it is 64 ASCII characters, no prefix) — a common cause is a trailing newline from a clipboard manager.

toolNotFound.help:
Install kubectl.

Nothing was sent anywhere and no credential was used: this check runs before any work starts, so trying again after installing is safe.
